name: PaperDesk Quiet Ink
principles: Use black ink on white, not opacity layers for normal interface text.
Keep Close at the upper right on primary screens and form screens.
Separate app identity from dense command rows.
Use a black primary action and outlined secondary actions.
Keep Save and validation feedback above the system keyboard.
Show the current value of toggles, not only the name of their next action.
Keep destructive actions secondary and require confirmation.
Prefer bounded scrolling and no decorative animation on e-ink.
implementation: Apps retain self-contained resource bundles and local controls; tests/qml/tst_design.qml enforces cross-app geometry. No new runtime plugin or font dependency.
intentionalExceptions: The SSH command strip adds 96px below the identity header to fit five readable actions.
Books retains its padded library shell; its Close button uses the same dimensions.
The native RDP engine has a separate bitmap renderer. Its renderer and network behavior are not changed by this UI pass.
Reading content, terminal cells, game grids and decorative captions have their own typography requirements.
